name: io.github.eddyflores100-lang/alethech
title: alethech
description: Read-only MCP bridge for alethech, a verifiable agent-memory protocol (Ed25519-signed, hash-linked DAG, key rotation under a root identity). Exposes two tools over stdio: alethech_memory_context (verified memory entries in causal order, treated as data not instructions) and alethech_memory_verify (HEAD and entry count). Launch requires --memory <path to .aleth container> and --passphrase-file <path>; credentials and paths are configuration, never tool arguments.
